statement: Reference entries document where an economic input can come from. SolarWise DZ never applies any of them automatically: every analysis uses the values supplied with the request. Entries marked OFFICIAL_REFERENCE cite a regulatory text; their amounts are deliberately left empty until someone has checked the text itself, because a remembered figure is not a reference.

entries.label: Public drinking-water service tariff (Algeria)
entries.source_title: Decret executif n. 05-13 du 9 janvier 2005 fixant les regles de tarification des services publics d'alimentation en eau potable et d'assainissement ainsi que les tarifs y afferents
entries.source_reference: Journal officiel de la Republique algerienne (JORADP); the tariff depends on the tariff zone, the user category and the consumption band
entries.applicability: Network water billed by a public operator. A plant in the desert is usually supplied by tanker or from its own borehole and treatment unit: the cost that matters is then the delivered, treated cost per cubic metre, which is site-specific and normally higher than the network tariff.
entries.notes: Title and number cited from memory of the regulatory framework; no amount is stored. Verify against the Journal officiel and the operator's current tariff sheet before use.

entries.label: Guaranteed purchase tariffs for photovoltaic electricity (Algeria)
entries.source_title: Arrete du 2 fevrier 2014 fixant les tarifs d'achat garantis et les conditions de leur application pour l'electricite produite a partir des installations utilisant la filiere solaire photovoltaique
entries.source_reference: Journal officiel de la Republique algerienne (JORADP), 2014; tariffs depend on installed capacity and on the annual full-load hours bracket
entries.applicability: Applies only to installations contracted under that guaranteed-purchase scheme. For any other plant the value of a recovered kWh is the price in its own power purchase agreement, or the avoided cost of the energy it displaces.
entries.notes: Title cited from memory; no amount is stored. The energy value of a specific plant must be taken from its contract.

entries.label: Regulated electricity tariffs for consumers (Algeria)
entries.source_title: Decision D/22-15/CD de la Commission de regulation de l'electricite et du gaz (CREG) portant fixation des tarifs de l'electricite et du gaz
entries.source_reference: CREG; tariffs depend on the tariff code, the voltage level and the consumption band
entries.applicability: A consumer tariff is what a customer pays, not what a producer earns. Used as the value of generated energy it is only a proxy (basis CONSUMER_TARIFF_PROXY): SolarWise shows the arithmetic but does not let a cleaning decision rest on it.
entries.notes: Reference cited from memory; no amount is stored.

entries.label: National guaranteed minimum wage, SNMG (Algeria)
entries.source_title: Decret presidentiel n. 21-137 du 7 avril 2021 fixant le salaire national minimum garanti
entries.source_reference: Journal officiel de la Republique algerienne (JORADP), 2021
entries.applicability: A legal floor for wages, not the cost of a cleaning crew. The labour cost of a cleaning is the loaded hourly cost of the crew (wages, social charges, transport, accommodation, supervision) or the contractor's price.
entries.notes: Reference cited from memory; no amount is stored. Check for later amendments.

entries.label: Energy value used in the demonstration scenarios
entries.applicability: Illustration only. Declared with basis INTERNAL_VALUATION so that the demonstration can reach every decision outcome.
entries.notes: An arbitrary round figure. It is not a tariff, a contract price or a market estimate.
